title: ArcEvents apocalypse: finite isolated expedition supplies
assumptions: Scenario, not telemetry: low/base/high=1/5/20 participants, 1/2/4 active hours/day, 2/8/32 ordinary supply barrels opened per participant-day and 1/3/8 medical barrels. Previously mode absent.

World loot is finite per generated container, shared between players; opening counts are exploratory scenarios, not a renewable per-player entitlement. Additional travel generates new locations, with no fixed global item budget.

The entry journal isolates the entire inventory, armor, offhand and native XP. Exit restores origin; expedition gear remains in saved expedition. Ender chest and external commands are blocked. No cash/token reward or shop/contract API is called. Lethal owned actors are removed before native death reward callbacks.

Standard supply: ammunition uniform12..32 (EV22), cooked beef uniform2..5 (EV3.5), iron ingot uniform1..3 (EV2), one of4 guns with chance.25, vaccine chance.2. Armory/core gun chance1. Medical vaccine1+bread4+honey1. Loaded rounds use the existing configured gun magazine; modeled separately from loose rounds and no monetary valuation.

Starter: one-time per expedition profile, source-equivalent axe wear42, bread9, vaccine6, iron boots, vanilla mask/binocular substitutes. Resume does not grant kit again; death does not reset the journal.

Zero external redemption is a design boundary, not an observed production ledger. Standard SELL and future SELL-to-contract transition remain unchanged. No item-to-currency exchange assumed. Multi-account accounts have separate starter profiles; supplies are shared only inside the expedition. Unknown third-party plugin commands/proxy bypass require native integration observation.

Journal entitlement precedes container materialization to avoid rerolls; a crash exactly between those writes can lose finite unmaterialized loot. No blind retry reissues an already-claimed container.
